what_happened: The job to give OLY-B-S2-01 a prompt-surface inventory mechanism and test was rejected at the final verdict. One of 7 acceptance criteria was unmet. That criterion is a new test that runs the inventory twice over every real studies/<id>/ directory. It must assert identical non-empty output, a spec entry with a real mechanism, the owner and the measure label, and fail on a "none" mechanism or an empty inventory. The verifier gave one major finding and no blockers: the inventory in prompts_inventory.rs (lines 28-66) lists cited instruction-like files, not every prompt surface of the instance. No checks are listed as failed.
cause: Nothing required the inventory's coverage to be defined against an independent list of what a prompt surface is, or compared with the real study directories, before the job counted as done. The test only needed the output to be non-empty and identical across two runs. A proxy such as cited files satisfies those checks, so determinism and non-emptiness stood in for completeness. The same measure-style job family keeps failing this way, and the producer is not told about the recurring gap.
other_causes: The unmet criterion asks for a test with a negative case, but the fields do not show that the test checks completeness, so a test that passes on a partial inventory could satisfy it.
The criterion says 'every real studies/<id>/ directory' without defining what counts as a prompt surface, leaving the producer to choose a proxy.
open_hypotheses: Whether the unmet criterion failed because the test does not exist or fails, or only because the inventory it exercises is incomplete: the fields give only the soundness finding.
Whether the request or the reading defined 'prompt surface' precisely, or the producer chose the narrower definition on its own.
contradictions: The earlier cases in the status-measure family were rejected mainly on D43 evidence or on false-positive counts, while this event has a soundness finding and no D43 finding, so the match to those cases is partial.
prevention: For any job that builds an inventory, census or measure, the reading must define the full set being counted and name an independent source to compare against. A criterion must require a test or real-data run showing that the output covers that set, with a negative case where a known surface is missing. Determinism and non-emptiness alone must not satisfy the criterion. A check before the final verdict should run the mechanism over the real data and compare its output with that independent list.
proposed_request: Fix the OLY-B-S2-01 prompt-surface inventory in crates/athena-cap-study/src/prompts_inventory.rs. It must list every prompt surface of each real studies/<id>/ instance, not only cited instruction-like files. A prompt surface is any file or text that tells an agent what to do: briefs, prompts, role files, defaults and instruction files, whether or not they are cited. Acceptance: (1) a test runs the inventory twice over every real studies/<id>/ directory and asserts identical, non-empty output; (2) the same test compares the output with an independently derived list of prompt surfaces for at least one real study and asserts that no surface is missing; (3) the spec entry has a real mechanism, the owner and the measure label; (4) negative cases in the same test file fail on a spec entry with mechanism "none", on an empty inventory, and on an inventory that omits a known uncited surface; (5) cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings and cargo test pass, with the commands that ran cited as evidence; (6) add the CHANGELOG.md entry.
